name: PagerDuty: page on case escalation
description: When a case is escalated to a tier, trigger a PagerDuty incident through the Events API v2. The incident's dedup key is the escalation's, so a later close resolves exactly this one.

secrets.name: PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY
secrets.description: PagerDuty Events API v2 integration (routing) key of the service that should be paged.

setup:
## PagerDuty side
1. In the service to page, add an **Events API v2** integration and copy its integration key. Store it as `PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY`, allowed host `events.pagerduty.com`.

## How it works
- Runs when a case is escalated (trigger `case.escalated`): `POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue` with `event_action: trigger`.
- `dedup_key` is `sochub-case-<case id>-esc-<escalation id>`; install *PagerDuty: resolve on escalation closed* so closing the escalation resolves the incident.
- Severity follows the case: critical → critical, high → error, medium → warning, anything else → info.


## Ack to accept
To let an acknowledgement in PagerDuty accept the escalation in SOC Hub, open **Settings → Integrations → Escalation paging**: the card shows the inbound URL to paste into PagerDuty (a Generic Webhooks (V3) subscription on the service, event *incident.acknowledged*). It is tied to this tenant.

payload.summary: [SOC Hub] Case #{{ case.id }} escalated to {{ trigger.changes.escalation.group.name }}: {{ case.title | truncate(150, True) }}
